briefing.headline: OpenAI o5 and DeepSeek R2 accelerate AGI timelines amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple reasoning models this month as funding surged past $15B quarterly. Geopolitical tensions rise with US and China both accelerating sovereign AI infrastructure. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability across deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o5 with native agentic planning; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek R2 matched GPT-5 performance at 40% lower inference cost; Meta open-sourced Llama 4 400B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target multi-agent environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units shipped; Microsoft and xAI announce joint 200k H100 cluster in Texas; TSMC 2nm AI chips enter volume production for Google TPUv6.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI-level model emerge from a US or Chinese lab by end of 2027?
